Household Pulse Survey (HPS)About · Using this site

About this site

This site describes the Household Pulse Survey (HPS), published by U.S. Census Bureau. It is generated from the repository pdt-pulse, which holds metadata built from the publisher's documentation: each variable's label, question text, codes and missing codes, and availability, with corrections and links between releases. Each fact says where it came from.

What it isn't

  • It isn't the publisher's site, and the publisher hasn't reviewed it. The publisher's own page for the dataset is https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/household-pulse-survey.html. Where this site and the publisher's documentation differ, the publisher's documentation is the source; the differences this repository knows of are listed as corrections.
  • It doesn't hold the data. The data come from the publisher, or from this repository's data release when the terms allow; see Getting the data.
  • It makes no analysis decisions: which answers count as agreement, which weights or cases to use, or how to recode. Those belong to the projects that use the data.

What they say
The Census Bureau's Open Government page: "The U.S. Census Bureau publishes its data as open data, meaning it is freely available for use and re-use by the public." The PUFs and their documentation are works of a US federal agency. The Census Data API's terms of service (https://www.census.gov/data/developers/about/terms-of-service.html) ask API products to say they are "not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau"; this repo doesn't use the API.

PublicDataToolkit

The library and the standard that build this site: https://github.com/AllenDowney/PublicDataToolkit. This site was generated by version 0.2.1.

Reporting an error

  • In the publisher's documentation (a wrong label, a missing code, question text that belongs to another item): open an issue at the issue tracker of the repository pdt-pulse, with where you found it. This repository records such errors as corrections, with the evidence, and keeps the publisher's original; it also says whether the error was reported to the publisher.
  • In this repository's records (a wrong link, a code classified wrongly, a variable left out): open an issue at the issue tracker of the repository pdt-pulse.
  • To the publisher: U.S. Census Bureau.
